::: {#rem-big-o-equals-sign}
#### The equals sign is one-way

$O(g(n))$ stands for a set of functions,
and $f(n) = O(g(n))$ says that $f$ belongs to it.
So $n = O(n^2)$ is true, but $n^2 = O(n)$ is false,
and the statement cannot be read from right to left.
@cormen2009introduction [section 3.1] and @arora2009computational [section 0.3]
use the notation this way.

:::
